name: DescribeResources

parameters.help_en: The resource ID. For example, for an instance, this is the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID。例如，当待查询的资源为实例时，可以理解为InstanceId
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: A filter for rules that failed the scoring
parameters.name: failed_rule_template

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. The service returns a token if the response is truncated. To retrieve the next page of results, include this token in your next request. If no token is returned, all results have been retrieved
parameters.help_zh: 分页游标，如果有下一页，则该字段有返回值。说明 该参数只要返回数据，则说明还有下一页。您可以将返回的NextToken作为请求参数再次获得下一页的数据，直到返回为Null，表示获取到了所有的数据
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The page size. Default: 10. Maximum: 100. Values less than 10 are set to 10, and values greater than 100 are set to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页行数。最大值为100。默认值：当不设置值或设置的值小于10时，默认值为10。当设置的值大于100时，默认值为100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_zh: ASC: 升序, DESC: 降序
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource category
parameters.name: resource_category_id

parameters.help_en: A list of resource owner IDs. Use this parameter for cross-account scenarios. If you omit this parameter, the service returns data for the current account by default
parameters.help_zh: 资源所有者ID列表，在跨账号场景使用，置空时默认获取当前账号的数据
parameters.name: resource_owner_ids
